dart.evidence: Pre-impact period around larger Didymos was about 11 hours 55 minutes. The orbital-evolution model reports the immediate reduction of 32m42s to 11h22m37s and a later settled period of 11h22m03s, a 33m15s reduction. Over the intervening weeks rocky material continued to escape and the period continued to shorten. The orbit became noncircular. Exact modeled period figures carry an estimated 1.5-second precision.

bennu.locator: Opening paragraphs and final-pour photo caption
bennu.evidence: Return to Earth was on September 24, 2023. The 60 g science requirement was reached before the sampling head was fully opened. The final pour contributed 51.2 g and the total sample mass was 121.6 g.

quake-1906.locator: M = 7.7, M = 7.9, and Why can't scientists agree
quake-1906.evidence: Seismic waves were recorded at 96 observatories, and 12 stations had records suitable for digitization and modeling. Those results suggested surface-wave magnitude 7.7. USGS re-evaluated geodetic measurements from before and after the event, assessing deformation with benchmark distances and angles. Their slip models suggested moment magnitude 7.9. The methods estimate earthquake size differently.

pq-standards.locator: August 13, 2024 notice, list and descriptions of all three standards
pq-standards.evidence: The Secretary of Commerce approved three standards. FIPS 203 is the module-lattice KEM for establishing a shared secret over a public channel. FIPS 204 is the module-lattice signature standard, and FIPS 205 is the stateless hash-based signature standard. They are designed to resist future quantum-computer attacks.

voting-age.locator: Amendment XXVI, enactment dates and sections 1 and 2
voting-age.evidence: Congress passed it March 23, 1971, and ratification followed July 1. It bars federal and state abridgment of US citizens' voting rights on account of age for those 18 or older. Section 2 gives Congress legislative enforcement authority.

git-sparse.evidence: Sparse checkout limits which tracked files appear in the working tree. Cone mode takes directories, includes their tracked contents recursively, and includes files immediately alongside the selected directory or its ancestors.

eia.locator: 2024 table, production and consumption columns, and data vintage note
eia.evidence: Electricity production is 30.7 trillion kWh total with 10.0 renewable (32%). Electricity consumption totals 28.5 trillion kWh with renewable quantity and share unavailable. Total energy production is 605.6 quadrillion Btu with 42.4 renewable (7%), and the consumption share is also 7%. EIA reports a July 1, 2026 data vintage subject to change.

faa.locator: What is happening, different types of hot spots, and why standardize
faa.evidence: On the May 19, 2022 chart cycle the FAA standardized three shapes and two meanings. Circle and ellipse are both ground-movement indicators. A cylinder represents wrong surface. The definitions concern collision or runway-incursion risk, and standardized depiction is intended to prevent confusion.
